name: Apimostinel
summary: Apimostinel (GATE-202, formerly NRX-1074) is an investigational antidepressant, acting as a novel and selective modulator of the NMDA receptor. It is currently under development for the acute treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD) by Syndeio Biosciences, and previously by Naurex and Allergan. As of February 2015, an intravenous formulation of apimostinel has completed a phase IIa clinical trial for MDD.

pharmacology.text: Apimostinel (GATE-202, formerly NRX-1074) is an investigational antidepressant, acting as a novel and selective modulator of the NMDA receptor. Similar to rapastinel (GLYX-13), its mechanism of action acts through a unique binding site on the NMDA receptor, independent of the glycine site, to modulate receptor activity and enhance NMDAR-mediated synaptic plasticity.

summaryZh: 阿匹替奈是一種正在研究的抗抑鬱藥，可作為NMDA受體的新型選擇性調節劑。目前，Gate Neurosciences正在開發該藥物，用於重度抑鬱症的急性治療。該藥物此前由此前Naurex和艾爾建開發。截至2015年2月，阿匹替奈的靜脈製劑已完成針對重度抑鬱症的IIa期臨床試驗。

sideEffects.en: It is still investigational, so its effects in people are not fully known. In early trials the reported effects were mild and did not include the strong dissociation seen with ketamine.
sideEffects.zh: 它仍在研究階段，因此對人體的影響尚未完全清楚。早期試驗中回報的反應輕微，且未出現氯胺酮那種強烈的解離感。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它仍在研究阶段，因此对人体的影响尚未完全清楚。早期试验中回报的反应轻微，且未出现氯胺酮那种强烈的解离感。

fact.en: Unlike ketamine, it is thought to adjust the NMDA receptor gently rather than blocking it, which was the idea behind trying to get an antidepressant effect without the dissociation.
fact.zh: 與氯胺酮不同，一般認為阿匹替奈是溫和地調節 NMDA 受體而非阻斷它，這正是嘗試在不造成解離的情況下取得抗憂鬱效果的構想。
fact.zhHans: 与氯胺酮不同，一般认为阿匹替奈是温和地调节 NMDA 受体而非阻断它，这正是尝试在不造成解离的情况下取得抗忧郁效果的构想。
